next.reason: 1985 first GENERATE: report heading, page heading, all control headings major to minor, then the detail (or part of detail processing for GENERATE report-name), with PH/PF per GR4. 2023: §2023:14.9.16.4 GR4 the same order, 'each control heading is printed, wherever defined, in order from major to minor', then 'The specified detail is printed, unless summary reporting is specified'; §2023:14.9.16.4 GR2 summary reporting is the same processing 'except that no detail is printed'; §2023:14.9.16.4 GR1 the detail 'following any necessary control break and page fit processing'; §2023:14.9.16.4 GR6 page advance; §2023:13.18.57.4 GR5 implicit printing and GR6 a)-c) per-type conditions. 'Following an INITIATE' matches 1985 GR7. Same effect.
